overview_description.description: Duna is an AI-native business identity platform built for banks, fintechs, marketplaces, and other regulated businesses. It streamlines customer onboarding, KYC, KYB, AML, and ongoing compliance through automated workflows, intelligent identity verification, and policy-driven decision making. By combining AI with a unified data platform and low-code tools, Duna helps organizations reduce manual reviews, improve onboarding speed, strengthen fraud prevention, and maintain regulatory compliance throughout the customer lifecycle.

about_short_description.short_description: Duna is an AI-native business onboarding platform for regulated companies such as banks, fintechs, and financial institutions.

product.name: Policy Engine
product.description: A system that translates compliance policies into executable code to automate compliance decisions and maintain detailed audit trails.

product.name: Onboard
product.description: A no-code platform for creating customizable, high-conversion business onboarding journeys with real-time data adaptation and deep localization.

product.name: Decide
product.description: An automated case management system that reduces manual compliance work by translating policies into tasks, prioritizing cases, and enabling secure communication.

product.name: Lifecycle
product.description: A compliance monitoring service that automates ongoing customer screening, re-KYC processes, policy updates, and legal agreement management throughout the customer lifecycle.

product.name: Data Platform
product.description: A data orchestration platform that integrates multiple KYC technologies and data providers, optimizing data routing and quality with redundancy to support compliance decisions.
